What Needs You
Show Everything

What Needs You, on Home, holds the questions you need to answer and the notices that tell you what happened. A question has its answers as buttons, such as File It or Keep The Account, and Dismiss. A notice says what happened: groceries you couldn’t pay for, a commitment you slept through, a welcome to the school. The number beside Home on the menu counts both.

Where To Find It
Home, The What Needs You Panel.
When You Can Use It
From “What Needs You”.
Show Me Where
What To Press
Open Home and read What Needs You: questions first, then notices.
Press one of a question’s answers to act on it from What Needs You, without opening its screen. An answer does what the same action does on the question’s own screen: File It, on your tax return’s question, files the return just as File It on Papers does.
Press Go There to open the screen a question or a notice is about.
Press Dismiss to take a question off the list without answering it.
Press Mark N Read, at the top of the panel, to mark every unread notice read at once.
Press Show All N, under the notices, to see every unread one before you do: the panel draws the six most important first, and Show The Six Most Important goes back to them.
Press a question’s or a notice’s title to open it: how urgent or important it is, when it closes, and where it sits in the list.

How This Works

Chase pays what the account can’t cover without an arrangement, and charges $34.00 for each item that overdraws it, at most 3 a day. There’s no fee on an item of $5.00 or less, or while the account is overdrawn by $50 or less. A fee waits until the end of the next business day, and if the account is back to −$50.00 or better by then, there’s none. Payments at the same moment post largest first. It covers up to about $500.

You haven’t opted in, so an everyday debit card purchase the account can’t cover goes on the card, or is declined, and costs no fee. Other payments, like autopay and standing orders, go into the overdraft either way. The law requires a US bank to ask you first.

Opt In To Debit Card Overdrafts

If Chase Total Checking is still overdrawn at the end of March 6, 2026, Chase takes what it’s owed from your other money there. If that isn’t enough, it closes the account, and the rest goes to collections and onto your credit record.

No Claim Open
How This Works

Filed now, it wouldn’t pay: New York asks for $3,500.00 in one quarter.

Once a claim is open, the game certifies each week for you on Sunday, from anywhere in the country, as an interstate claim allows. What it pays is taxable income on your return.

A week with work pays a share of the benefit by the hours worked, and nothing once the pay reaches the maximum, counting the work you did that week, even if it’s paid later. A week pays nothing if you’re abroad, a full-time student in Connecticut or without permission to work in the US, or in hospital or laid up by an injury when it’s certified. Work-study wages come from your school and don’t count toward a claim’s base period.

OPT

Form I-765, (c)(3)(B), after your degree

How This Works

OPT is permission to work in your field after your degree, and it keeps your US status going. The game has no work after the degree, so an approved OPT ends after 90 days without work, about 90 days from its start, and your US status ends with it.

It costs $470.00. Premium processing costs $1,780.00 more and gets you a decision within 30 business days. OPT follows a completed degree: if school ends without yours, it’s denied when it’s decided, and the fee isn’t refunded.

Canada	Canada has no route for a freelance actor. Its Self-Employed Persons Program is paused until further notice, and Express Entry has no category for the arts.	

Ireland	Ireland has no route for a freelance actor, because an employment permit needs an employer’s offer.	

Mexico	Mexico grants temporary residence on savings of MXN 1,344,373 or an income of MXN 79,771 a month over six months, with the card at MXN 11,140.74 a year and the consulate’s visa at US$56. Moving abroad isn’t part of the game, so you can’t get Mexico’s papers here.
